title: Iconography / scale and context

location.series: Jessie W. Lee / Verizon Master Brand Redesign

slide_intent: Test an icon beside real text and controls so its legibility survives changes in scale and use.
strategic_value: Context testing can keep Verizon’s icon family usable in dense navigation and prominent feature messages.
demonstration: An online-shopping benefit list and account navigation sit beside 2x, 3x and 4x monitor/icon pairings, followed by a phone shopping screen.
practical_value: Compare the icon-to-text relationship at several scales and in both light and dark interface contexts.

content_islands.name: Compact uses
content_islands.spec: Stack the shopping benefits list over the dark navigation example at left.

content_islands.name: Scale comparison
content_islands.spec: Arrange three monitor-and-headline pairings vertically in the middle, preserving the 2x, 3x and 4x labels and x-height guides.

content_islands.name: Mobile application
content_islands.spec: Place the tall phone screen at right to show the symbols within a complete shopping interface.

reference_purposes.Application: The same icon language appears at several relative scales in navigation, benefits and a mobile shopping page.
